expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The promo banner's white text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') sits on a very light mint green background, making it nearly illegible and far below WCAG contrast minimums.

The third card in 'Fastest near you' ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped hard at the screen edge with its title truncated mid-word and no ellipsis or partial-peek framing, so it reads as broken rather than scrollable.

The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark circular background with a white heart.
The category filter chip row is cut off at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip visible, giving an accidental-clipping appearance.
The second 'Popular right now' card is abruptly clipped by the bottom tab bar with no fade or spacing, and its title/metadata are not visible at all.
The notification bell's red dot indicator conveys unread state by color alone and has no visible text label or count.
